mapper.sql: SELECT t.id AS task_id, t.assignee_id, t.task_type, t.task_key, i.tenant_id, i.business_module_code, i.business_module_name, i.business_type, i.business_key, i.business_title, i.project_ref, i.project_name, i.action_path FROM wf_task t JOIN wf_instance i ON i.id = t.instance_id AND i.tenant_id = t.tenant_id
mapper.select: WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND t.id = #{taskId} AND t.assignee_id = #{assigneeId} AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.business_type IS NOT NULL
WHERE t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.instance_id = #{instanceId} AND t.status = 'PENDING' AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.business_type IS NOT NULL ORDER BY t.id

LEFT JOIN sys_notification n ON n.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND n.business_type = i.business_type AND n.event_id = CONCAT('workflow-task:', t.id, ':assignee:', t.assignee_id) WHERE t.status = 'PENDING' AND t.assignee_id IS NOT NULL AND i.deleted = 0 AND i.business_type IS NOT NULL AND n.id IS NULL ORDER BY t.created_at, t.id LIMIT 200
SELECT starter_id FROM wf_instance WHERE id = #{instanceId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0
SELECT id, username, display_name, org_id FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{operatorUserId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 1
SELECT id, code, status FROM wf_definition WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND code IN #{code}
